create_DataParallel_module: create a DataParallel module to parallelize a PyTorch neural network across multiple GPUs
run_data_parallel_function: run a PyTorch module in parallel across GPUs using the data_parallel functional API
test_DataParallel_balance: test GPU balance and warn when devices have less than 75% of memory or cores of the strongest GPU
build_DataParallel_forward: build a DataParallel forward pass that scatters inputs across devices, replicates the module, and gathers outputs
review_DataParallel_replicate: review DataParallel replicate to create module copies on each specified device for parallel execution
